name: Easy Sausage and Pea Orzo Risotto

ingredients.name: Italian sausage, removed from its casing

instructions.primary_message: Heat the oil into a medium saucepan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up into small pieces until no longer pink. Add the shallot and sauté until translucent, about 1 minute. Add the orzo and water or stock. Use a wooden spoon to help scrape any of the brown bits on the bottom of the pan from the sausage. Bring to a boil, then cover, and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the orzo has absorbed all the liquid and is cooked through (add more liquid if orzo starts to dry out or stick to the bottom). Season to taste with salt and pepper. Stir in the peas, and allow to cook for a minute or two just to thaw. Remove from the heat, and stir in the Parmesan and parsley. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: Dinner for Two, orzo, pastas, peas, quick, risotto

description: A thick, hearty orzo risotto, more foolproof than the rice variety, full of sweet Italian sausage, peas, and Parmesan.
notes:
Optional or for serving: A handful chopped flat-leaf parsley (optional)

Optional substitutions: hot water → low-sodium vegetable stock or chicken stock
author: Kerry Saretsky
